runtimeShadow.filter: Four nearest depth comparisons with bilinear weights; existing dynamic-light filters remain unchanged

policy.scope: Bounded static architectural occlusion of the existing warm directional light. Main sun retains dynamic actor shadows.
policy.casters: Original full building geometry, original fixed facade fittings, and loaded V02 static architectural meshes; no actors, train, aircraft, vegetation or debris.
policy.transparency: Transparent materials do not cast opaque architectural rim shadows. Mixed original facade glazing requires a per-vertex reflectance depth mask.
policy.invalidation: Rebuild on source mesh/geometry or saved world-matrix changes and building damage/destruction; source visibility culling does not remove static casters.
policy.fidelity: PCF depth-map approximation to source SUN occlusion; no claim of Cycles soft-shadow or complete material equivalence.
